title: Fibrewise ampleness yields uniform local twisted-cohomology vanishing and section lifting
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: One must obtain a single twist bound across every infinitesimal thickening of the fibre. The proof packages the layers as a finite graded module over the associated graded base algebra, then combines exact-sequence induction, formal functions and Nakayama to transfer vanishing and section surjectivity back to the local base.
